verdict.rationale: ByteAsk documents an `exec` subcommand explicitly for scripting and CI pipelines that runs one task to completion and exits, supports JSON Lines streaming output, JSON Schema-conformant output for parsing, and sandbox flags to allow non-interactive build/test/write actions — all core requirements for non-interactive automation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs, and no example CI pipeline config shown.
